text: Just finished my first half marathon at 2:04:31!! Legs are destroyed but I can't stop smiling. Thank you to everyone at Tuesday club who dragged me through the long runs.
Anyone else's Garmin been dropping GPS under the bridge on the river loop? Mine says I ran a 3:10 mile there yesterday and I promise I did not.
Hot take: the 10% rule is made up and nobody who actually follows it gets faster.
Looked back at my log. In the 8 weeks I did one strides session a week my 5k went 24:10 to 23:22. Same mileage before and after. Strides are underrated.
Is it normal for my shins to hurt two days after a run and not the day after? New runner, about 3 weeks in, running 3x a week.
Saturday's group run is moving to 7:30 instead of 8 because of the heat. Meet at the usual spot by the boathouse.
Carbon plated shoes for easy runs is a waste of money and probably bad for your feet. Save them for race day.
Bonked hard at mile 20 today. Took a gel at 5, 10, 15 and still hit the wall. What am I doing wrong with fueling?
I did my first run without walking breaks today. 30 minutes straight. A year ago I couldn't run to the mailbox.
Track workouts are overrated for anyone running slower than a 25 min 5k. Just run more easy miles.
Ran the city 10k this morning in pouring rain. 51:02, a 90 second PR. Rain running is the best running, change my mind.
Compared my heart rate data from this summer and last. Easy pace at 140bpm went from 11:20/mi to 10:05/mi over 12 months of mostly zone 2. Slow running works, it just takes forever.
What do people do with their keys on long runs? My shorts pocket keeps bouncing and it's driving me nuts.
Nobody needs a coach for a first marathon. Download a free plan and follow it.
That moment when you pass someone on the hill repeats and they say "nice job" and you can't even breathe to answer. Sorry guy in the orange shirt.
Plantar fasciitis has had me out for six weeks. Seeing a PT next week. Anyone have exercises that actually helped?
Watching the Chicago marathon coverage and I am screaming. That final mile was unreal.
The marathon distance is too long for most recreational runners and the half should be the default goal race. More people would stick with running.
Cadence advice is mostly nonsense. 180 steps per minute came from counting elites at race pace, not jogging.
Signed up for my first ultra. 50k in April. Terrified and excited in equal measure.
How early do you eat before a morning race? I get stomach issues if I eat anything less than 3 hours before.
My running buddy just qualified for Boston by 4 seconds. FOUR SECONDS. I'm so proud I could cry.

Data point for the "do you need rest days" crowd: I ran every day for 400 days straight and my average pace got slower in the last 100 as fatigue built. Took 5 days off and ran a 10k PR the next week.
Treadmills are just as good as outdoor running. The 1% incline thing is a myth according to the study it supposedly came from, which used much faster speeds.
Is it worth buying a GPS watch as a beginner or should I just use my phone?
Our club's beginner group graduated eleven new runners from couch to 5k this spring. Seven of them ran the park run on Saturday.
Just got passed by a woman pushing a double stroller uphill. Humbled.
Stretching before runs does nothing. Dynamic warmup or just start slow.
Why does my left calf always cramp around mile 8 but never my right?
Took 3 minutes off my half PR by switching my long runs to include the last 3 miles at goal pace. 1:52 to 1:49 in one training block.
Running in the cold is easier than running in the heat. Fight me.
Lost a toenail after the marathon. Welcome to the club I guess.
Does anyone know if the trail by the reservoir is open again after the flooding?
Most running injuries are caused by doing too much too soon, not by shoes or form.
Finally broke 20 minutes in the 5k after trying for two years. 19:57. I'm shaking.
Strava segments ruin easy runs. Turn off the leaderboard notifications.
Checked the race results from last year. Of the 812 finishers in my age group, the median time was 4:38. Most of us are just out here having fun.
Can I run a marathon on 25 miles per week? Work schedule doesn't allow more.
Nike Vaporflys made me 2 minutes faster in the half. Same course, same fitness, one month apart.
That Kipchoge interview about consistency is the best running advice I've heard all year.
Hydration vests look silly but I don't care, they're amazing for long trail runs.
Shoutout to the volunteers at mile 18 handing out orange slices. You saved my race.
My knees hurt when I run downhill but not uphill. Is this an IT band thing or something else?
Barefoot running is a fad that injured a lot of people in the 2010s and nobody talks about it anymore.
Got chicked by a 70 year old at the turkey trot. She ran 26 minutes. Goals.
Running clubs are the best way to stay consistent. I quit three times on my own and stuck with it once I joined.
What's a good first race distance for someone who has been running about 4 months?
The new course map for the spring half takes out the big hill at mile 9. Last year 34% of DNFs happened between miles 8 and 10, so this should help a lot.
Ran with a pacer for the first time. Hit 1:45 exactly. Pacers are magic.
Race photos are a crime against humanity. I look like I'm being chased by bees in every single one.
Heart rate training is overcomplicated for beginners. Just run at a pace where you can talk.
Is it bad to run on an empty stomach in the morning? I usually just have coffee.
My 8 year old ran her first 1 mile fun run today and asked when the next one is. Proud parent moment.
Got lost on the trail run and accidentally did 14 miles instead of 10. Still counts.
Running twice a day is pointless unless you're over 60 miles a week.
Anyone have a recommendation for a physical therapist who works with runners in the area?
My resting heart rate dropped from 72 to 58 over the year I've been running. Didn't change anything else.
Rain jackets for running are useless. You'll be soaked from sweat anyway.
How do you all stay motivated to run in winter? It's dark when I leave and dark when I get home.
Shoes from 2015 were better. Every new release has more foam and less stability.
Did the 800s workout tonight with the club, 6x800 at 3:30 with 2 min rest. Felt strong until the last two.
Beer mile is this Friday after the track session. Bring your own cans. Non-alcoholic division exists.
Positive splits are not a moral failing. Most first marathoners blow up and that's how you learn.
Why does everyone hate on the Hansons plan? It worked great for me.
Hansons plan got me from 4:12 to 3:51. The cumulative fatigue thing is real, my legs were tired every long run but race day felt easy.
I can't believe they canceled the marathon two days out because of the heat warning. I trained for 18 weeks.
The cancellation was the right call. It was going to be 88 degrees by 10am and two people died at a race in similar conditions in 2007.
Lululemon running shorts are overpriced for what you get.
Does anyone run with music? I've been told it's bad for pacing.
Just saw a fox on my morning run. Best part of the week.
Run streaks are bad for you. Recovery matters.
Mile repeats today: 6:45, 6:41, 6:38, 6:40. Negative split the workout for the first time ever.
Should I run through a cold if it's just in my head? Heard the "above the neck" rule.
Parkrun is the single best thing to happen to amateur running in the last 20 years.
Thanks for the advice on fueling last week. Switched to gels every 30 min instead of every 5 miles and didn't bonk at all on my 20 miler.
Not sure I'm cut out for marathons. The training takes over everything.
New to running at 45. Is it too late to get decent?
Started at 47, ran my first sub 2 hour half at 51. It's never too late.
Speedwork twice a week will get you injured if you're under 30 miles a week.
That hill on Maple Street is the worst thing in this city and I will die on it. Literally maybe.
Race fees have gotten ridiculous. $180 for a local marathon is insane.
Looked it up: the city marathon cost $85 in 2012 and $165 now. Inflation alone would put it around $115. The rest is extra.
Do compression socks actually do anything?
The research on compression socks during running is mixed at best. A 2017 meta-analysis found small effects on recovery soreness but nothing on performance.
Ran a 5k in a dinosaur costume for charity. Got second in my age group somehow.
Group runs should have a no-drop policy for every pace. Nobody should finish alone.
What's the best way to do hill repeats if you live somewhere totally flat?
Bridges. Find a bridge or a parking garage. I did 10 reps of a parking garage ramp every week before Boston.
Foam rolling is mostly placebo but placebo is fine if it gets you out the door.
My watch says my VO2 max dropped 3 points after a week of vacation. Should I be worried?
Watch VO2 max estimates swing with heat, sleep and terrain. Mine moved 4 points in a week with no change in training.
First trail race this weekend. Any tips for someone who has only run on roads?
Downhills on trails will destroy your quads if you haven't trained them. Ask me how I know.
People who run on the bike path two abreast need to learn how to share.
Ran 13.1 on the treadmill today because of ice. Two hours staring at a wall. Never again.
Splits from my marathon: 8:30 for the first 13, then 9:45 average for the second half. Classic blowup. Went out 20 seconds too fast per mile.
You don't need to eat during a half marathon.
Is a 10 minute mile considered slow? Asking for myself.
There's no such thing as a slow mile. You lapped everyone on the couch.
Running form analysis at the shoe store is a sales tactic.
Wore my new shoes for a race without breaking them in. Blisters on blisters. Learn from me.
Can someone explain tempo vs threshold vs lactate threshold? They seem like the same thing.
Club t-shirts are here! Pick them up at Thursday's run. Sizes S through XXL.
Running at night with a headlamp in the woods is a whole different sport and I love it.
Why are race start times so early? 6am starts mean a 4am alarm.
Early starts are about heat and road closures. The city only gives permits until noon for the full course.
Got my first DNF today. Pulled out at mile 16 with hip pain. Feeling pretty low.
Fueling with real food on ultras is better than gels. Boiled potatoes with salt are elite.
Just ran 3 miles without stopping for the first time ever. I'm 34 and have never been athletic.
Supershoes have made running records meaningless.
The women's marathon world record dropped by more than 2 minutes in the supershoe era, but times also dropped in races where nobody wore them. It's not only the shoes.
Accidentally joined the 7 minute pace group instead of the 9 minute group. I lasted half a mile.
Anyone want to split a hotel room for the Philly marathon? Looking for one more person.
Heat acclimation is real. My easy pace in July was 45 seconds slower than in April at the same heart rate.
Taper is making me crazy. Every ache feels like an injury.
Taper madness is real but the data says it works. In my last three marathons the ones with a 3 week taper were 4 to 6 minutes faster than the 1 week taper.
Is running on concrete worse than asphalt for your joints?
Running is the cheapest sport. All you need is shoes.
Running is not the cheapest sport. Between shoes, races, watches, and gels I spent $1,400 last year.
Got a cramp in my side at mile 2 every single run this week. What causes those?
Saw a guy running in jeans at the half marathon today. Absolute legend.
Running coaches on Instagram are mostly selling the same plan in a different font.
We had 64 people at Thursday's run, the most ever. Love seeing this club grow.
Marathon training made me gain weight. Is that normal?
Totally normal. Muscle glycogen stores water, and most people eat more than they burn during peak weeks.
Recovery runs are junk miles.
Running slower made me faster. Took me four years to believe it.
Is it better to run in the morning or evening for performance?
Ran my long run with a friend for the first time instead of alone. 16 miles felt like 8.
The Boston qualifying cutoff this year was 6:51 under the standard. Making the standard means nothing anymore.
My half marathon time has been stuck at 1:58 for three years. What would you change?
You can't outrun a bad diet.
Nobody told me how emotional the last mile of a marathon would be. I was sobbing at mile 26.
How do you count elevation gain for a trail run? My watch and Strava disagree by 600 feet.
Barometric altimeters on watches drift with weather. Strava corrects using a map elevation model, which usually reads lower on twisty trails.
Did anyone else get the email that the bib pickup moved to the convention center?
Running in a group makes you run too fast on easy days.
Track etiquette: slower runners use outside lanes. Please. I almost got run over at the Tuesday workout.
Hit 1,000 miles for the year this morning. Didn't think I'd make it after the stress fracture in March.
Stress fractures are almost always about low energy availability, not just mileage.
Is the 30-30 rule for lightning a real thing for runners? Got caught in a storm yesterday.
Pacing a friend to her first sub 4 on Sunday. Any advice for being a good pacer?
Most running apps overestimate calories burned by 20 to 30 percent.
What's the protocol if someone in the group gets hurt mid-run? Do we have a club policy?
Ran the ten mile loop and saw three other club members out. This city has gotten so much more runner friendly.
Marathon recovery: I waited 2 weeks before running again and felt worse than when I ran easy 3 miles on day 4 last time.
Strength training is the most underrated thing for runners. Two sessions a week fixed my knee pain.
Two months of squats and deadlifts and my knee pain went away. Physio said my glutes were basically asleep.
How much do you all actually spend on running shoes per year?
I rotate three pairs and log every mile. Last year's shoes averaged 410 miles before the midsole felt dead.
Should I run a race if I'm not fully recovered from a cold? It's a 10k this weekend.
Running is a meditation. Anyone who tracks every metric is missing the point.
Going to cheer at mile 22 on Sunday with signs. Who's in? Bring cowbells.
The new running store downtown gives 15% off if you show your club membership card.
Is it weird to run alone at 5am as a woman? I'm nervous about safety.
Run with a buddy or share your live location. Our club also has a 5:30am group that meets by the library.
Altitude training doesn't help unless you live there for weeks.
Spent a week in Denver. My easy pace was 40 seconds slower per mile the first 3 days and back to normal by day 6.
Can I train for a 5k and a marathon at the same time?
Garmin training readiness is garbage. It told me to rest the morning I set a PR.
Our club's average 5k time at the last time trial was 26:14, down from 27:40 in spring. Group workouts are paying off.
Grateful for this community. Lost my dad last month and the Saturday group runs have been the only thing keeping me sane.
Running in snow is fun until you hit ice under the snow.
Yaktrax or microspikes? Need something for icy morning runs.
Microspikes. Yaktrax broke after two weeks on mixed pavement for me and two others in the club.
Elite marathoners should be required to wear the same shoes so we can compare eras.
Just did a 3 hour long run and didn't drink anything. Is that dangerous?
Hydrating to thirst is enough for most runs under 2 hours. Past that it depends on heat and sweat rate.
How do you deal with chafing? I tried Body Glide and still got destroyed.
Ran my first 5k in a wheelchair racer today. Thanks to everyone who cheered.
Every runner should run at least one race in a costume. It changes everything.
Race report: Coastal Half. Windy as anything. Went out at 7:50 pace, held 7:55 average, 1:43:45. Mile 11 into the headwind was brutal.
The hills on the new course added about 3 minutes to everyone's time. Median finish went from 2:08 to 2:11.
Is 40 miles a week enough to break 3:30 in the marathon?
I broke 3:30 peaking at 42 miles. The key was the long runs with marathon pace segments.
Running podcasts are better than music for long runs. Time flies.
Anyone know a good place to get gait analysis that isn't trying to sell me shoes?
Kenyan runners are fast because of genetics. It's that simple.
It's not just genetics. Iten has thousands of runners training at altitude with group culture and running to school as kids. The environment matters a lot.
I dropped from the 10 min group to the 9 min group this month. Small win.
The fact that there's no water station between mile 4 and 9 is dangerous. Someone will collapse.
Signed up for a race in a city I've never been. Running is the best excuse to travel.
Treadmill pace and outdoor pace aren't the same. Treadmills feel harder.
Should I do a marathon or an ironman first?
My race was cut short to 24 miles because the course was measured wrong. Does that still count as a marathon?
Can't believe we got 2 inches of rain and everyone still showed up for track. This club is unhinged in the best way.
Long run pace should be 60 to 90 seconds slower than marathon pace. Most of us run them way too fast.
Ran my long runs 75 seconds slower than goal pace this cycle instead of 30. Marathon went from 4:01 to 3:44.
Anyone else get runner's trots? How do you plan routes around bathrooms?
Morning running ruined my sleep schedule and I don't regret it.
Training plans should be personalized. Copying elite plans gets beginners hurt.
Halloween run Thursday! Costumes encouraged, candy at the finish.
Just found out my coworker runs 100 mile races. Mind blown.
What's the difference between a fartlek and intervals?
Does anyone else feel like running 5ks is harder than marathons?
A 5k at max effort is way harder than a marathon. The marathon is long, the 5k is painful.
Took my first rest week in four months and I'm going stir crazy.
The more I run, the more I realize nobody cares about your pace except you.
Finally convinced my partner to come to the Saturday run. She did the 3 mile loop and wants to come back!
I'm starting to think race medals are pointless. Mine are all in a drawer.
Why does running feel so much harder after Thanksgiving?
Overtraining is mostly an excuse people use for bad races.
Overtraining is real. My HRV dropped from 68 to 41 over three weeks of increased volume and my easy pace got slower. Took a week off and it recovered.
